name: Financial Assistance to Commercial Tiatr Troupes/Directors/Producers for Stage Setting
benefit:
- Financial assistance as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa will be provided to six commercial tiatr troupes/directors/producers annually for stage setting development.
- Disbursal is made only upon completion of fifteen performances of the tiatr mentioned in the application.
- Payment is processed as a one-time benefit per beneficiary.

_*Tiatr Academy of Goa logo must be displayed on the front visib
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must have been on the commercial tiatr stage for at least five years. - The applicant must have five years experience on the commercial tiatr stage along with the application. - The applicant must be a commercial tiatr troupe, director, or producer. ***Selection Process*** - A maximum of six commercial tiatr troupes/directors/producers will be selected annually. - If more than six applicants apply, selection will be decided by way of lots. - Remaining applicants will be wait listed and provided with financial assistance in the following financial year. - In case of withdrawal by any selected applicant, the next applicant on the waiting list will be given preference for allotment.
